The sections of this page are in four modules of the companion curriculum: [Panel data](panel-data.qmd) holds the country-year level, the linear model, clustered standard errors, the two fixed-effects designs, standard errors with few clusters, and within and between; [Multilevel models](multilevel.qmd) holds the multilevel models, survey weights and bounded outcomes; [Bayesian estimation](bayesian.qmd) holds the Bayesian model of the panel; and [Meta-analysis](meta-analysis.qmd) holds the common scale and the five analysts.
